title: Ask your test data in plain words: AI charts
description:
Ask Atlas, VirtualPyTest's AI assistant, about your test runs in plain language. It answers from the same data and definitions as the Grafana dashboards: pass rate by device, the KPI radar of an interface, only the regressions over 10 %, or a whole canvas of panels for two devices, in one sentence. Every answer exports to CSV, JSON, SVG, PNG, a report or a Grafana draft.

Open source and free.
